subject: Computação
description_pt: Analisar o consumo de tecnologia na sociedade, compreendendo criticamente o caminho da produção dos recursos bem como aspectos ligados à obsolescência e a sustentabilidade. Selecionar e utilizar tecnologias computacionais para se expressar e resolver problemas, analisando criticamente os diferentes impactos na sociedade.

components.description_pt: Analisar a cadeia de produção de um recurso tecnológico, desde a matéria-prima até o descarte
components.description_en: Analyze the production chain of a technological resource, from raw materials to disposal
components.cc_component_description: Identify natural resources used as raw materials in the production of specific synthetic materials

components.description_pt: Avaliar questões de obsolescência tecnológica e seus impactos ambientais e sociais
components.description_en: Evaluate issues of technological obsolescence and their environmental and social impacts
components.cc_component_description: Assess potential social, cultural, and environmental impacts of a proposed engineering solution

components.description_pt: Avaliar preocupações de sustentabilidade relacionadas ao consumo de tecnologia na sociedade
components.description_en: Assess sustainability concerns related to technology consumption in society
components.cc_component_description: Construct an evidence-based argument linking human population and consumption trends to environmental change

components.description_pt: Selecionar tecnologias de computação apropriadas para autoexpressão ou resolução de problemas em um contexto
components.description_en: Select computing technologies appropriate for self-expression or problem solving in a given context
components.cc_component_description: Select appropriate tools, technologies, or models to analyze a given scientific data set

cc_matches.description: Gather and make sense of information to describe that synthetic materials come from natural resources and impact society.

Evaluate a solution to a complex real-world problem based on prioritized criteria and trade-offs that account for a range of constraints, including cost, safety, reliability, and aesthetics as well as possible social, cultural, and environmental impacts.
Construct an argument supported by evidence for how increases in human population and per-capita consumption of natural resources impact Earth's systems.
Analyze data using tools, technologies, and/or models (e.g., computational, mathematical) in order to make valid and reliable scientific claims or determine an optimal design solution.
